description: This file is a script designed to scan through TypeScript source files within a specific directory to detect usage of raw window.open calls that are considered unsafe. It provides functions to identify such calls, collect their locations, and enforce a policy by warning or exiting if violations are found.

methods.name: asPropertyAccess
methods.description: Converts an expression to a property access expression if possible.

methods.name: isRawWindowOpenCall
methods.description: Checks if a given expression is a call to raw `window.open` or `globalThis.open`.
